tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: Find private after-school care facilities in Tokyo by ward, feature, pickup school, fee ceiling, closing time and more. Returns compact rows; fees with their conditions, pickup schools and the application route are in get_facility. null = not published by the facility (要問合せ), never 0.

tools.name: get_facility
tools.description: Full details of one facility: hours, pickup schools, fees with their conditions, source URL, verification date, and the page where a parent applies. null = not published by the facility (要問合せ), never 0.

tools.name: list_wards
tools.description: The Tokyo wards covered, with facility counts, the feature tags, the data date, and the rules for using the data.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search across facility names, areas, wards, operators, tags and pickup schools. Returns ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one facility by id (as returned by search), as readable text plus its page url.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
